item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.mechanism: Unwind-days U_i(T) = OI_notional_i(T) / mean daily dollar turnover (trailing 28d). Gross perp position stock relative to routine risk-transfer capacity. Heavy books relative to capacity are vulnerable to forced-deleveraging cascades whose damage is undercompensated; entry liquidity at the crowded moment is deceptive (displayed depth overstates realizable liquidity exactly when crowded books unwind).
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.economic_counterparty: the forced deleverager (auto-liquidated leveraged positions); cascade flow exceeds ordinary counterparties absorption capacity
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.why_edge_exists: crowding is priced by attention, not by exit capacity; liquidation cascades are long-side dominated in aggregate crypto positioning (Cheng et al. 2021: 3.51 pct long vs 1.89 pct short of OI per day), so down-cascades destroy more value than up-squeezes create and the vulnerability is undercompensated in expected return
item_01_hypothesis_and_mechanism.expected_sign: cross-sectionally LOW unwind-days outperforms HIGH unwind-days over the next week; long bottom tercile, short top tercile; signal contains no OI time-difference, no return term, no funding term, no price-impact term

item_02_falsifiable_prediction.prediction: after base costs the anchor earns positive BTC-beta-adjusted weekly excess in at least 2 of 3 frozen folds, the 56d neighbour shows the same sign, and the static-scale control does NOT pass the same gate in the anchor direction
falsified_if_any_of: anchor beta-context excess not positive in >= 2/3 folds
static-scale control reproduces the anchor gate outcome (edge is raw positioning scale, not capacity normalization)
item_02_falsifiable_prediction.on_falsification: family rejected; control never promotable to a family
